prompt: Lou sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Lou charges extra to sell soup, but only free soup brings the crowd back to buy.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Frost paints the diner windows as a tall pot of soup steams on Lou's counter.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy sits in a booth, hungry for hot soup, reciting burn facts to delay the first sip.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Shivering Murphy enters with empty pockets as Sterling's truck music lures the line outside.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup, stamping cold feet as steam curls up.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Lou charges extra for a big bowl, and Teddy's careful blowing test leaves Murphy sipping cold air.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Benny gives his small bowl to Murphy, and Teddy's giant blow sends noodles sliding across the table.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup, stamping cold feet as steam curls up.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou counts lonely coins behind the counter, watching cold hands shake around empty bowls.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou lifts the ladle high, declaring free warm cups for every cold nose today.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Lou ladles free soup as the crowd sings, learning giving fills more bowls than charging.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Frost still paints the windows, but full bellies laugh together in Lou's warm diner.
